statement: The first-pass index distribution ADR-0008 named as the measurement that would settle sampling breadth is entirely concentrated at index 0 on the top local rung, and the breadth default of 1 stands. Method: the pinned 20-task JS/TS set was run with one greedy draw (T=0.0) and five serial sampled draws (T=0.7, DEC-6's own operating point, N=5 its own proposal) per task, no early exit, through the shipped prompt assembly (build_prompt, bundle selected by adapter) and mcgyvr's own dispatch path, on qwen3-coder-next-ud:q3_K_XL (digest 499a5d0084fe, identity recorded not asserted — the tag says Q3_K_XL, Ollama's details say qwen3moe/30.5B/Q4_K_M, and the 33.8 GiB blob fits neither reading at face value) served by Ollama on srv2 (RTX 3060, ~11 GB of the blob in VRAM, heavy CPU offload) over the OpenAI-compatible path. Result: 120 candidates, 0 dispatch errors; a gate-passing candidate existed within five sampled draws on 20 of 20 tasks and on 20 of 20 it was draw 0, so cumulative pass@<=k is flat at 20/20 from k=1. Greedy passed 18/20; sampled draws passed 96/100 (per-draw 20/18/20/18/20); only t03 and t07 ever failed any draw, and the one parser refusal in 120 was a truncation at the 768-token cap. Wall clock per additional candidate was 12.5 s dispatch + 0.1 s acceptance, so N=5 spends ~63 s per task on this rung against budgets.task_timeout_s's default 900 while buying nothing: every task's winner was already in hand after draw 0. The saved candidates supply the mechanism for part of the concentration: on 10 of 20 tasks at least two sampled draws were byte-identical, and on five (t10-t13, t17) all five sampled draws were one text identical to the greedy draw — at T=0.7 this rung's output distribution collapses to its mode exactly where it is confident, so there breadth has nothing to select over by construction; where diversity did appear (t01-t08, t20, five distinct texts each, including both tasks that ever failed) draw 0 still always won. Scope and limits: 'gate-passing' is the acceptance proxy CLM-0012 used (parse refusal or the contract's declared suite; the full Gate.run adds rungs this task set does not exercise); the task set sits near this rung's ceiling, so the regime where breadth could pay is sampled by exactly two tasks and both landing at index 0 carries ~0.36 evidence under independence — the decision rests on the asymmetry that keeping the default needs no power while raising it needed spread-out indices and none appeared; sampling at 0.7 showed no variance penalty (96/100 vs 18/20, inside the +/-1-task noise floor CLM-0012 measured), which licenses 'no penalty observed', not 'sampling helps'; one rung, one task set, one serving stack, and a weaker rung could show spread this run cannot. Consequence: #119 ships breadth defaulting to 1 citing this record; raising the default is justified only by a future run of the same instrument showing mass off index 0.

citations.supports_because: States the method, the run identity including the deliberately unresolved model-identity contradiction, the full distribution table, the per-draw pass rates, the candidate-collapse mechanism and every limit above — including that 18 of 20 tasks never failed a draw, which is the fact most capable of making concentration at zero look stronger than it is.

The 120 raw rows — one per draw with arm, draw index, temperature, latency, prompt and completion tokens, stop reason, parse refusal code, acceptance verdict and candidate sha256 — so the distribution, the per-draw rates and the wall-clock figure can be recomputed rather than trusted.

The manifest recorded before the first dispatch: endpoint, protocol, model, N, both temperatures, the cap, the shipped bundle's sha256 and a sha256 per task contract — the identity a resume is refused against, which is what keeps these 120 rows one experiment.

One of the 120 raw completions vendored under candidates/ (one file per draw, pass or fail, parseable or refused). This exemplar is the fifth sampled draw of t10 and is byte-identical to that task's other four sampled draws and its greedy draw — the collapse-to-mode mechanism as checkable bytes rather than an inference, with the sha256 column in results.jsonl tying every such file to its row.

The instrument, re-runnable against any reachable endpoint. It dispatches through mcgyvr's own Request/runner_for/parse_reply, uses the shipped prompt assembly, and never exits early on a pass — the property (held by test) that makes the index distribution an observation rather than an artifact of production's first-pass-wins selection.

The decision this measurement discharges: it fixed the default at 1 on the best evidence then available, named this exact measurement as the cheap unproposed one that would settle it, and defined the bar — spread-out first-pass indices — that the observed distribution fails to meet.
